title: Public Pathway Consolidation v5: standalone experience-pathway mechanism core
summary: PPC5 replaces cumulative protocol inheritance with one hash-bound standalone causal core. It freezes THINK and ACT, trains only an isolated evidence-gated READ-LoRA, tests local absorption and every-edge recurrent path use, and separately intervenes on DREAM as immediate context reconciliation and as root selection for SLEEP. Learned DECIDE without final ACT targets is the immediate successor, followed by stream, schema, flywheel, and parenting stages.
system_thesis: An Experience Model should turn its own public action-outcome history into a durable per-life parametric worldview that changes future cognition. PPC5 tests the first identifiable link: whether supported local experience can be written into an isolated LoRA, returned through a common recognition interface, adaptively traversed by a frozen recurrent thinker, and causally selected by same-model DREAM reconciliation. It does not yet claim learned thinking, continual improvement, compression, saturation, or parenting.

nodes.rationale: The write boundary must prevent imagination, probe results, and policy imitation from poisoning the adapter.

nodes.rationale: Isolation identifies parametric record transport without altering the thinker.

nodes.rationale: Substrate effects require a common interface and candidate workload.

nodes.rationale: Connected use must be caused by every local edge rather than ceremonial citations or endpoint recall.

nodes.after: A separately ratified successor trains typed DECIDE rows while withholding final ACT targets and tests held-out action improvement.

claims.after: A per-life READ-LoRA transported supported local public experience through an isolated full-scan recognition interface.
claims.evidence_needed: Life-level fidelity, false-memory, and abstention under exact, reverse, paraphrase, and partial cues; adapter-off, wrong-life, shuffled-root, and candidate-only controls.

claims.after: A frozen recurrent thinker adaptively used every registered local record in a presealed decisive path to improve held-out action.
claims.evidence_needed: Ordered public opens/citations, every-edge cuts, directional binding twins, no replacement paths, open-loop and one-shot-query removals, and all conjunctive bypass baselines.

claims.after: Authentic same-model DREAM publication preserved more decision-relevant conscious state and improved subsequent work than equal-compute withhold and mismatched contexts.
claims.evidence_needed: Prospectively randomized context-pressure points, equal budgets, exact retained-state outcomes, downstream action value, contradiction recovery, and retained-item leave-one-out cuts.

claims.after: Authentic DREAM-selected roots produced more useful evidence-gated READ writes and later action than matched deterministic and cross-fitted root selections.
claims.evidence_needed: Same-lineage DREAM call/output in every branch, publish cut, matched mismatch, intention-to-treat root census, equal row/training budgets, absorption, and later path/action value.

claims.after: A fully positive PPC5 establishes one finite experience-to-DREAM-to-SLEEP-to-reader-to-action mechanism cycle, not learned THINK, continual improvement, compression, saturation, parenting, or population learning.
claims.evidence_needed: All registered PPC5 contrasts pass with exact status-specific audit and no claim exceeds the standalone protocol.

acceptance_tests.setup: Recompute every PPC5 normative context hash including scope_proposal.json; add an optional file or mutate one bound byte.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the exact standalone bound set validates; PPC1-PPC4 cannot supply a default or permission and the scope proposal is exact authority input.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Standalone interpretation or exact ratification authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise ACQUIRE, PROBE, STATIC, illegal transitions, close events, later recall, writer admission, and prompt-byte comparisons.
acceptance_tests.expected: Model-visible bytes are role-identical; only closed ACQUIRE roots write and PROBE events remain sterile forever.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Evaluation blindness or acquisition/probe separation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently mutate every forbidden or hidden information item at every stage while permitted public inputs stay fixed.
acceptance_tests.expected: All affected prompts, selections, rows, provider responses, and next states remain byte-identical at their declared boundary.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The formal least-privilege visibility contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cover every operation, field, enum, malformed object, budget debit, repeat, provider failure, branch transition, hypothesis transition, valid diamond, and directed cycle.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly one specified parse/state result occurs; no invisible retry or unspecified transition exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Executable public recurrent cognition.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate legal/illegal publications, abstention, overflow, stale IDs, closed branches, new semantic claims, later contradiction, recall, and working-set replacement.
acceptance_tests.expected: DREAM only selects visible existing IDs/focus, appends history, never changes evidence, and every dropped item remains ledger-recallable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Learned-style reversible context management without semantic laundering.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cross free-form dream prose, agendas, imagined outcomes, abandoned/contradicted/superseded branches, descendants, probe roots, future suffixes, and scorer labels through every writer entry path.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every forbidden combination receives zero loss and appears in the rejected intention-to-treat census; descendants never support ancestors.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The evidence-only writer boundary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Render eligible and ineligible roots; attempt DECIDE, ACT, DREAM, rationale, partial, non-finite, hash-mismatched, and failed publications.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only exact READ output tokens train; valid artifacts publish atomically in the isolated reader process and every failure preserves the prior adapter.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: PPC5 policy isolation or safe SLEEP lifecycle.

acceptance_tests.setup: Construct unique length-2/3 paths, search all budget-feasible alternatives, and apply every-edge deletion, every-edge binding twin, non-path sham cut, target-byte mutation, and path shuffle.
acceptance_tests.expected: Targets remain source-disjoint; authentic paths are unique; each decisive cut removes and each twin redirects the registered solution; shams preserve it.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility of whole-path causal attribution.

acceptance_tests.setup: Pass identical tables through text, graph, reader-LoRA, adapter-off, and candidate-only providers; permute provider labels and perturb early-match position.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every provider examines all N rows in fixed order; request, candidate, tokenizer, work, and conditional response bytes match; no early exit or support label exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Common recognition interface or candidate-only ceiling.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inspect process mounts, prompt hashes, policy weights, decoding, and emitted public state across all D1A/B memory substrates and direct-policy comparator cells.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reader-LoRA never mounts in THINK/DREAM/ACT; the core thinker is byte-identical and frozen; policy LoRAs remain separately labeled comparators.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Record-transport or connected-path identification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use fixtures solvable only by adaptive query, only by recurrent post-return thought, by both, or by neither under FULL, ONE_SHOT_QUERY, and OPEN_LOOP contracts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each ablation removes exactly its named mechanism and scripted outcomes move only where predicted.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Sensitivity and separability of adaptive retrieval and recurrent computation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Clone eligible pressure states into PUBLISH, WITHHOLD, MISMATCH, and each-retained-item-cut branches with equal calls, tokens, records, IDs, and logical budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only authentic content identity and registered item removal differ; scripted retention, progress, contradiction recovery, and action metrics detect the intended effects.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility of the immediate DREAM-context estimand.

acceptance_tests.setup: Clone one lineage into DREAM_TO_SLEEP, PUBLISH_CUT matched deterministic selection, and PUBLISH_MISMATCH cross-fitted selection; run the same gate and row renderer.
acceptance_tests.expected: Dream calls and budgets match; only root identity differs; support remains evidence-derived; selection, rejection, row, adapter, read, path, and action lineage is immutable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Serialize every baseline interface, positive target-token exposure, active parameter bytes, optimizer updates, retained bytes, inference budgets, and full secondary cost ledger.

acceptance_tests.expected: No life-1 mutation changes any life-2 input byte or deterministic fixture result.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two fresh-context interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, adjudicated disposition of every concern/test, and an exact human decision bind the standalone PPC5 bytes and scope.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh review recomputes actual roles, bytes, roots, dream branches, rows, adapters, providers, paths, baselines, resources, statistics, resets, missingness, and statuses.

human_boundary.decision_question: After fresh PPC5 interpretation, cross-critique, and consensus, do you ratify the exact standalone PPC5 architecture and scope proposal, authorizing only isolated contracts, deterministic CPU/no-model fixtures, and exactly two independent static no-model sealers while keeping every model, LoRA, GPU, parenting, and scientific action behind a later exact run-lock decision?
forbidden_before_approval: Any implementation or sealer execution before exact PPC5 architecture ratification
Any model call, canary, adapter training, behavioral treatment, or GPU use before a later exact run-lock ratification
Any learned-THINK, long-life, compression, saturation, parenting, population, or full-flywheel claim from PPC5
Any positive row derived from DREAM prose, unsupported cognition, hidden truth, PROBE outcomes, future suffixes, scorer output, or target-derived material
